newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan Oct jet tender has floating price option.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Oct jet tender has floating price option.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a jet fuel buy tender which gives sellers the option for the first time to offer on a floating-price basis, a company official said on Friday.
The tender seeks to 32,000 tonnes of jet fuel for delivery during October 1-31, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Keelung or Shen Ao. It closes on September 17 and offers should be valid until September 19.
CPC last Thursday cancelled its tender to buy jet fuel for delivery in October due to high offers.
A company offical said at that time that CPC would consider issuing a fresh tender after it received offers ranging from just under $250 to over $260 per tonne c-and-f basis.
The latest tender gives sellers the option of offering on a floating basis against prevailing published Singapore spot quotes.
"Traders said that they can offer a better price if it (the prices) is on a floating basis," a CPC official said.
"Depending on the offers, we may take either on floating or fixed price basis," said the official.
